provenance.author: BoardFlow
sources: Agricola rulebook (Lookout Games / Z-Man Games, 2007 edition)

steps.text: Each player: a farmyard with a Wooden hut tile on both building spaces and a Family member in each
Remove Occupations not used at your player count; deal each player 7 Occupations
steps.note: First games: Family game on p.8, without Occupations or Minor Improvements

steps.text: Each player takes a Summary card
Choose a starting player: Starting player marker and 2 Food; everyone else 3 Food
3 game boards side by side; other pieces sorted beside the play area
Round cards: shuffle each Stage, stack Stage 6 at the bottom up to Stage 1 on top
Green Action cards for your player count faceup left of the first board: {s}
10 Major Improvements faceup on their board; Begging cards beside the play area
No green Action cards: the left-hand spaces of the left board stay empty, as in the 2-player game
The Starting player marker only moves when someone takes the Starting player action
Round 1: turn over the top Round card
